metadata.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 — view over the Living Control Set
metadata.remarks: Profile resolution over the Living Control Set (control-library.oscal.json). Selection derived from the authored NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 mapping in framework-crosswalk.yaml: the 36 owned controls that carry one or more of the 110 Rev 2 security requirements. Requirement-level refs live in the crosswalk; SPRS weights (DoD Assessment Methodology v1.2.1) travel with the assessment workbook, not this profile.
